messages:
elaine: Quick sync / private deploy roadmap decision points: installer profiles, upgrade downtime, customer-managed networking.
jasper: Short list pls. We need decisions before next field workshop.
maria: Field demand: 'thin' (no relay, customer egress) + 'ops' (relay + support). Also want allowlist snippet.
frank: Upgrade ask: in-place minor patches without full rebootstrap. We must confirm KV cache compatibility.
jasper: Engineering plan: minor = rolling operator upgrades (~30s per node); major = bundle swap with maintenance window.
netops: Network tiers: relay-managed, customer-nat (outbound-only), airgapped. Each needs different docs.
elaine: Proposed milestones: Q3 alpha = thin + relay-toggle + preflight; Q4 = minor in-place with canary + auto-revert; Q1 = major upgrade runbook.
maria: Pilot customers prefer CLI-first installer. They also want explicit allowlist lines for NetOps.
frank: Installer thin profile example:
``
installer.profile: thin
network.mode: customer-nat
egress.allowlist: ["x.x.x.x"]
operator.upgrade.strategy: rolling
```
jasper: Preflight must validate egress, DNS, TLS to control-plane, and RBAC for operator. Fail with remediation steps.
netops: We'll produce a one-pager checklist for customers (endpoints, TLS SNI, port 443 test).
maria: Canary policy: 1 node or 5% tenants, auto-revert on error spike, and a manual revert token option.
frank: Note: KV cache compatibility is minor-only; major requires migration hooks and operator-runbook.
elaine: Launch criteria shortlist: (1) thin+ops profiles implemented, (2) preflight + docs, (3) minor upgrade validated with canary+rollback, (4) network toggle + allowlist guidance security-reviewed, (5) major runbook drafted.
jasper: Timeline ok. Q3 for alpha items, Q4 for canary automation, Q1 for major runbook. Need legal/security sign-off on allowlist wording.
maria: I'll recruit 3 pilots for Q3. CLI-first accepted.
frank: I'll prototype revert token and runbook snippets.
deploy-bot: Jira RDW-PRIV-321 created for "thin/ops installer + preflight".
elaine: Action items: jasper templates + preflight (1w); frank runbook + revert prototype (2w); maria pilots (2w); netops checklist (1w). Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
